history_variable_reconciliation.finding_F1748_R08_resolution: Conclusively verified as physical behavior of un-degraded strain energy density in severed elements.
history_variable_reconciliation.physical_mechanism: In the Amor/Miehe strain-history formulation, H = max_t psi_0^+(eps) evaluates the strain energy density using the un-degraded elasticity tensor. Once an element is fully broken (d -> 1), stiffness degrades by g(d) ~ 1e-7, so physical stresses drop to zero, but crack-opening strains eps grow very large. Evaluating psi_0^+ with large crack-opening strains causes H to reach thousands of kN/mm^2 inside severed crack elements.

history_variable_reconciliation.scientific_implication: Raw history H is unsuitable as an unclipped linear indicator because severed crack elements are orders of magnitude larger than active process-zone elements. Phase-field damage d in [0, 1] is bounded and self-normalizing, making d and ||grad d|| the superior physical refinement variables.
